# Barsky Design

> Portfolio of Hiram Barsky — Lead Product & AI Designer based in Clifton, NJ. Ships design work as working software: React front ends, Supabase back ends, solo end-to-end builds.

## Pages

- [Home](https://barskydesign.pro/): Senior UX designer portfolio with case studies in AI, fintech, healthcare, and cyber — measurable user outcomes and product design impact.
- [About](https://barskydesign.pro/about): Senior UX/Product Designer with 15+ years building data-driven, AI-powered platforms. Based in Clifton, NJ, serving clients nationwide.
- [Services](https://barskydesign.pro/services): Senior product design with an AI build crew: research, UI, and working software from one person. Fintech, healthcare, and zero-to-one products.
- [Case Studies](https://barskydesign.pro/case-studies): Selected case studies across health, financial, and enterprise — what I decided, what I cut, what shipped. Honest writeups, not portfolio fluff.
- [Store](https://barskydesign.pro/store): Professional design resources, wireframe kits, and UX templates to accelerate product development. Instant digital downloads.
- [Blog](https://barskydesign.pro/blog): Insights on UX design, AI integration, design systems, and product strategy — practical lessons from 15+ years in the field.
- [Contact](https://barskydesign.pro/contact): Ready to transform your product? Book a call to discuss your vision, UX challenges, or collaboration in Clifton, NJ and beyond.

## Case studies

- [Enterprise Data Search — UX Case Study](https://barskydesign.pro/case-studies/dae-search): Enterprise search redesigned around the inconvenient truth that finding the data is only half the job — knowing whether to trust it is the rest.
- [Fire Lion — AI-Built Game Design Case Study](https://barskydesign.pro/case-studies/fire-lion): Shipping a multi-mode game with ruthless deletion discipline and AI-scaffolded design.
- [HerbaLink — Healthcare Marketplace UX Case Study](https://barskydesign.pro/case-studies/herbalink): Verified herbalists, designed around trust — in a category where bad advice has medical consequences. Designed, built, and shipped solo.
- [NudgeMe — Natural Language Reminder App Case Study](https://barskydesign.pro/case-studies/nudgeme): Progressive web app that turns plain-language input into smart reminders with multi-channel delivery and RFC 5545 recurrence.
- [ROI Design Builder — Design Value Calculator Case Study](https://barskydesign.pro/case-studies/roi-design-builder): Interactive calculator that turns design investment into projected ROI, helping teams make the business case for UX work.
- [Valora Bet — Social Prediction Markets Case Study](https://barskydesign.pro/case-studies/valora-bet): Social prediction markets platform turning opinions into shared outcomes with transparent odds and community-driven markets.
- [CatchBuddy — Safe Sports Matching Case Study](https://barskydesign.pro/case-studies/catchbuddy): Designing a safety-first matching loop before layering monetization.
- [Ring-Rival — AI Boxing Game Case Study](https://barskydesign.pro/case-studies/ring-rival): A shipped boxing game with distinct AI opponents, generated trash talk, and hand-tuned game feel.

## Live products

- [CatchBuddy — Safe Sports Matching Product Overview](https://barskydesign.pro/project/catchbuddy): Designing a safety-first matching loop before layering monetization.
- [HerbaLink — Healthcare Marketplace UX Product Overview](https://barskydesign.pro/project/herbalink): Verified herbalists, designed around trust — in a category where bad advice has medical consequences. Designed, built, and shipped solo.
- [Valora Bet — Social Prediction Markets Product Overview](https://barskydesign.pro/project/valora-bet): Social prediction markets platform turning opinions into shared outcomes with transparent odds and community-driven markets.
- [NudgeMe — Natural Language Reminder App Product Overview](https://barskydesign.pro/project/nudgeme): Progressive web app that turns plain-language input into smart reminders with multi-channel delivery and RFC 5545 recurrence.
- [Ring-Rival — AI Boxing Game Product Overview](https://barskydesign.pro/project/ring-rival): A shipped boxing game with distinct AI opponents, generated trash talk, and hand-tuned game feel.
- [Fire Lion — AI-Built Game Design Product Overview](https://barskydesign.pro/project/fire-lion): Shipping a multi-mode game with ruthless deletion discipline and AI-scaffolded design.
- [ROI Design Builder — Design Value Calculator Product Overview](https://barskydesign.pro/project/roi-design-builder): Interactive calculator that turns design investment into projected ROI, helping teams make the business case for UX work.
- [Fintech Loan Platform — Investment UX Product Overview](https://barskydesign.pro/project/investor-loan-app): Replacing Excel as the system of record for multi-million-dollar loan deals — without anyone losing their workflow.
- [ManuscriptRx — Pharma Email AI Product Overview](https://barskydesign.pro/project/email-creation-ai): AI handles the work between humans across a 6-step regulated email workflow.
- [Crypto Trading — Fintech UX Product Overview](https://barskydesign.pro/project/crypto): A self-initiated trading concept designed for two audiences the industry insists you have to choose between.
- [SplitTime — Co-Parenting App UX Product Overview](https://barskydesign.pro/project/splittime): A co-parenting app designed around the fact that every interaction is potential evidence.
- [QR Code Builder — Branded QR Generator Product Overview](https://barskydesign.pro/project/qr-code-builder): Branded QR code generator with custom styling, logos, and analytics for marketing campaigns.

## Blog

- [Learning AI Design with Claude: A Designer's Starter Kit](https://barskydesign.pro/blog/learning-ai-design-with-claude): How to get from zero to shipping AI-assisted design work using Claude as your daily thinking partner.
- [Prompt Engineering for Designers: From Brief to Pixel](https://barskydesign.pro/blog/prompt-engineering-for-designers): Prompts are the new design brief. Here is the structure that consistently turns a vague ask into usable output.
- [Designing AI-Native Interfaces: Patterns Beyond the Chatbox](https://barskydesign.pro/blog/designing-ai-native-interfaces): The chat bubble is the iframe of the AI era — useful, lazy, and rarely the right answer.
- [ChatGPT vs Claude vs Gemini for UX Workflows](https://barskydesign.pro/blog/chatgpt-vs-claude-vs-gemini-for-ux): I ran the same week of design work through all three. Here is where each one actually pulled its weight.
- [Building Your First AI-Powered Prototype in a Weekend](https://barskydesign.pro/blog/ai-powered-prototype-weekend): A two-day plan to go from idea to a working AI prototype your users can actually click through.
- [Designing Trust into AI: Handling Hallucinations and Uncertainty](https://barskydesign.pro/blog/designing-trust-into-ai): Users do not lose trust when AI is wrong. They lose trust when it is wrong and pretends to be sure.
- [From Figma to Production with AI: A Modern Designer's Stack](https://barskydesign.pro/blog/figma-to-production-with-ai): The handoff is dead. Here is the AI-assisted stack I use to ship designs straight into a live React app.
